The issuer exhibits a solid financial profile with revenue of $1.45B, strong profitability (EBIT margin of ~23.2% and ROA of ~2.7%), a healthy current ratio of 1.35x, and moderate leverage (total debt/liabilities to assets of ~64.8% and an equity base of $2.39B). These investment-grade characteristics demonstrate good debt-servicing capacity and financial flexibility, though balanced by substantial total liabilities relative to total earnings.

DECISION: BBB
